$comment: compute_gate data that skill_eval.py reads at import (plan.md:846). values: the two gate thresholds, in the eval-policy.json entry shape. messages: one template per compute_gate predicate or note, keyed by the predicate id of skill_eval.GATE_PREDICATES, with %(field)s fields that the predicate supplies. The predicate bodies and the problem-or-note decision stay code. Part of the rule bundle hash (ruleset_sha256).

AGREEMENT_MIN.note: H: grader-vs-human agreement below this is a gate problem. Moved from eval-policy.json by A5.

REGRESSION_TOLERANCE.note: H: any drop of mean pass_rate counts as regression. Moved from eval-policy.json by A5.

regression-baseline.source: house: with_skill below its baseline by more than REGRESSION_TOLERANCE

regression-previous.source: house: with_skill below the previous iteration by more than REGRESSION_TOLERANCE

low-agreement.template: low grader agreement: %(agreement).2f < %(threshold).2f on %(n)d golden examples

not-calibrated.template: grader not calibrated for this iteration (run `calibrate --golden ...`)
not-calibrated.source: house: a note when the iteration has no calibration.json

coverage.source: house: the per-tool coverage note (skill_eval.coverage_note), never a problem

static-failures.template: failing static checks in with_skill runs: %(count)d
static-failures.source: house: static checks fail in with_skill runs

run-stopped.source: house: plan.json records that the run stopped

no-plan.template: incomplete: no plan.json, expected run counts unknown
no-plan.source: house: no plan.json, so completeness is unknown

eval-runs-incomplete.source: house: fewer graded eval runs than planned

trigger-runs-incomplete.source: house: fewer trigger runs than planned

trigger-errors.template: execution failed [%(engine)s]: %(errors)d trigger run(s) with errors
trigger-errors.source: house: trigger runs that ended in an error

comparisons-incomplete.source: house: fewer blind pairwise comparisons than planned

unbound.template: unbound: plan.json records no skill/eval-set hash; re-run the iteration
unbound.source: house: the iteration is not bound to a skill and eval set hash

stale-skill.template: stale: the skill changed after this iteration ran (re-run before trusting this report)
stale-skill.source: house: the skill folder hashes elsewhere now

stale-eval-set.template: stale: the eval set changed after this iteration ran
stale-eval-set.source: house: the eval set hashes elsewhere now

stale-rules.template: stale: rules changed since this iteration ran
stale-rules.source: plan.md:844 (A5): ruleset_sha256 moved since the iteration ran

stale-rules-unrecorded.template: stale: rules changed since this iteration ran (plan.json records no ruleset_sha256)
stale-rules-unrecorded.source: plan.md:844 (A5): the iteration ran before ruleset_sha256 was recorded

execution-errors.source: house: eval runs that ended in an error

trigger-failed.source: house: with_skill trigger queries that missed their criterion

llm-ungraded.source: house: LLM items without a grade

human-pending.template: ungraded: %(count)d human item(s) pending review (fill human_review.json, re-run grade)
human-pending.source: house: human items without a review
